[P2] Isolate deferred export failures from parent scope setup

This drain runs inside `on_user_function_start`, before `_attach_context`. When replay registers a parent whose pending callback export raises, `_render_operation_end` propagates the exception because `_finalization` is still `None`. Core contains it and runs the parent's body without attaching its OTel context, so user-created spans and correlated logs acquire the enclosing parent instead. Later retries cannot repair that ancestry. Contain ordinary failures per pending completion while preserving retry state and allowing parent setup to finish. Cover this with a failing-processor replay test; Execution view's registration drain needs the same protection.
